title: NexoAIChat
description: NexoAIChat is a highly configurable AI chat plugin developed by NexoPlugins. Connect your server to the latest AI models from multiple providers and let players interact with an intelligent chatbot directly in-game.
body:
# 🤖 NexoAIChat

Bring powerful AI directly into your Minecraft server.

**NexoAIChat** is a fully configurable AI chat plugin developed by **NexoPlugins**. It allows your players to communicate with the latest AI models directly from Minecraft using either chat mentions or a command.

Simply choose your AI provider, select a model, enter your API key, and you're ready to go.

---

## ✨ Supported AI Providers

NexoAIChat supports the latest models from providers such as:

- OpenAI
- Grok (xAI)
- Google Gemini
- DeepSeek
- OpenRouter

Simply select your provider and model in the configuration.

---

## 💬 Chat Interaction

Players can interact with the AI in two different ways.

### Mention Mode

Mention the bot directly in chat.

Example:

```text
@NexoAI How do I build an automatic farm?
```

You can configure:

- The bot's name
- Whether an `@` symbol is required to trigger the AI
- Whether chat mentions are enabled

---

### Command Mode

Players can also use:

```text
/ai <message>
```

If desired, you can disable chat mentions completely and only allow the command.

---

## 🎭 Custom AI Behavior

Configure the AI's behavior with your own system prompt.

For example, you can make it act as:

- A Minecraft helper
- A server assistant
- A friendly chatbot
- Or anything else you want

---

## 🌍 Public or Private Replies

When a player mentions the AI in global chat, you can choose whether it should:

- Reply in global chat, or
- Send its response only to the player privately.

---

## 🎟 Daily Message Limit

Limit how many AI requests each player can make per day.

When a player reaches the configured limit:

- Chat mentions no longer work.
- The `/ai` command no longer works.
- The player receives a customizable message informing them that they have used all available messages for the day.

---

## ⚙ Fully Configurable

Everything can be configured inside the config.yml, including:

- AI provider
- AI model
- API key
- Bot name
- AI behavior
- Mention settings
- Whether an `@` symbol is required
- Daily message limit
- Public or private replies
- All plugin messages

---

## ❤️ Why NexoAIChat?

NexoAIChat lets you use your favorite AI provider without being locked into a single platform. Whether you prefer OpenAI, Grok, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, or another supported provider, switching is as easy as changing the configuration.

Simple to set up, flexible to configure, and designed for modern Minecraft servers.

---

Developed by **NexoPlugins**
